groups.sentence: Instructors align their course AI policies and syllabi with university policies and academic integrity rules.
Administrators ensure AI systems, units' policies and implementation comply with laws and existing university policies.
Students familiarize themselves with university and course AI policies before using AI tools.
Students keep university academic integrity, conduct and technology policies in mind and use AI lawfully and honestly.
Instructors follow FERPA, privacy and university policies when using AI.
Students comply with privacy, data protection, FERPA, HIPAA and export laws when using AI.
Everyone follows copyright and intellectual property laws when using AI.
AI use can create public records or violate law and policy, bringing disciplinary or legal consequences.
Everyone complies with existing university policies and applicable laws when using AI.
Existing university policies and laws continue to apply to AI use and are not replaced by AI guidance.
Students follow the university's academic integrity policy, honor code, student conduct code and course rules when using AI.
Everyone follows university data privacy, information security, IT acceptable use and data governance policies when using AI.
Everyone does not use AI in ways that are illegal or violate university policy or academic integrity.
University AI policy is required by, aligned with or subordinate to state, system or board regulations.
Staff use AI in compliance with institutional guidelines, export rules and applicable policy.
